notes.title: Numen: Content of Heroes Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Numen: Content of Heroes have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Fixes:
  • dragging of quest items into the inventory now works as it should
  • letter about dog's whistle now correctly drops
  • line wrapping in the Load game menu fixed
  • a few typing errors corrected
New Features
  • auto-save when leaving to the main menu or quitting the game
  • new screen resolutions of 1600x900 and 2560x1600 added
  • invert mouse Y-axis option added
